messages:
Anna: quick heads-up — prepping a tiny hotpatch for 1.10.3, minimal diff only. target cutoff tonight 18:00 PT. asking for changelog nudge and 1 quick CR from @Devon before cutoff.

Devon: on it, can you paste the PR list? I can eyeball for risk.

Anna: PRs: #4123 (fix TLS reconnect), #4127 (guard null in tokenizer), #4130 (version bump + changelog). no migrations. no config toggles.

Priya: tagging telemetry — is this going to flip any sampling flags?

Anna: nope, telemetry unchanged. only a defensive null check + tiny perf guard. verified locally with unit tests.

Devon: quick skim — looks fine. main concern would be the TLS reconnect change; can you add a short test that simulates reconnect? if CI covers it, i'm fine to approve.

Anna: CI is green for the branch but i'll add one extra test. pushing in ~10m.

Sam: deploy window? happy to do a quick smoke and rollback plan.

Anna: aiming for 18:30 PT deploy — want a 30m window (18:30-19:00). rollback plan: revert tag -> force-promote previous. Sam, i'll add the rollback steps to the release notes.

Devon: approve incoming once extra test is in. please include the cherry-pick SHA in the changelog.

Anna: will do. cherry-pick commands for reference:
```
git checkout release/1.10
git cherry-pick abc1234def
git cherry-pick def456ghi
git push origin HEAD:release/1.10.3-hotfix
```

Sam: copy that. i'll prepare the canary route with 5% traffic for 10m then ramp. if any errors >10% in error-rate we'll rollback.

Priya: can we add a short post-deploy eval for token cost regressions? quick embedding regen smoke?

Anna: yes, adding a tiny eval script to run post-deploy. will post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: CI status — release/1.10.3-hotfix: 3/3 checks passed (unit, integration, linters). :white_check_mark:

Devon: approved. :thumbsup:

Anna: thanks — i'll merge PR #4130 after adding the test, then cut the tag and ping here when ready for Sam to deploy.

Sam: standing by. ping me ~5m before cut. :alarm_clock:

Anna: will do. small reminder to keep the changelog entry short: "1.10.3: TLS reconnect fix, tokenizer null guard, misc stability". no user-facing changes besides reliability.

Devon: sounds good. quick note — avoid touching the DB migration file, even if tempted. tiny diffs only.

Anna: agreed. keeping it minimal.

Priya: thanks team, i'll watch telemetry and post any anomalies.

Anna: thanks all — cutting close but should be straightforward. :pray:
